checks.name: sample orders
checks.sql:
-- Fictional orders; all money values are USD cents.
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE orders (
  order_id VARCHAR, destination VARCHAR, weight_g BIGINT,
  revenue_cents BIGINT, product_cost_cents BIGINT
);
INSERT INTO orders VALUES
  ('A-101', 'US',  500, 3500, 1800),
  ('A-102', 'US', 1800, 2400, 1600),
  ('A-103', 'CA', 1200, 4000, 2600),
  ('A-104', 'GB',  700, 6000, 2800),
  ('A-105', 'AU',  900, 3000, 1400);
SELECT count(*) FROM orders

checks.name: quotes for orders
checks.sql:
SELECT order_id, destination,
  shipping.main.quote_cents(
    destination, weight_g
  ) AS shipping_cents
FROM orders
ORDER BY order_id

checks.name: orders needing attention
checks.sql:
WITH quoted AS (
  SELECT *,
    shipping.main.quote_cents(
      destination, weight_g
    ) AS shipping_cents
  FROM orders
)
SELECT order_id, destination, shipping_cents,
  revenue_cents - product_cost_cents
    - shipping_cents AS margin_cents
FROM quoted
WHERE shipping_cents IS NULL
   OR revenue_cents - product_cost_cents
        - shipping_cents < 0
ORDER BY margin_cents NULLS LAST, order_id

checks.sql: SELECT shipping.main.quote_cents(NULL::VARCHAR, 500::BIGINT), shipping.main.quote_cents('US', NULL::BIGINT), shipping.main.quote_cents('US', 0::BIGINT), shipping.main.quote_cents('AU', 500::BIGINT)

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM range(10000) WHERE shipping.main.quote_cents('US', (range % 100 + 1)::BIGINT) = 550
